record.evidence_quote: PEO-based SPEs have a conductivity of about 10−7 to 10−5 S/m at room temperature [17, 18]
record.notes: Generic range for PEO-based solid polymer electrolytes quoted from refs [17, 18], not a value for a specific composition; a range rather than a single number. Mobile ion assumed Li from the LiTFSI/PEO context. All simulated (MD) conductivities for LiTFSI-PEO +/- SiO2 appear only in figures and were not extracted. The activation energy given in the text (32.39 J/mol) is not a conductivity and was not used.
